part4_rescore_d3.found_rule: part-4 found: every gold quote of the record occurs (parts 2-4 normalisation, text hit) in the chunks of the cell's delivered context; for a top-10 cell that is the top 10 of the cell's ranked list. Not the gold-chunk-id rule of `stats` (gold rule 'any'): it is an ALL-quotes rule (nearest `stats` analogue: --gold-rule all), and a text hit counts any chunk whose text holds the quote, so a quote whose text recurs in another chunk (overlap, repeated passages) can be found without the gold chunk id being in the top 10. The file holds no ranks or chunk ids, so this cannot be re-scored by id here.
